horoscope: The Sun begins its transit of your adventure and spirit sector today, where it will visit until December 21st, dear Aries. The desire for more than just the usual routine sets in, and seeking experiences beyond the ordinary can become a big focus in the weeks ahead. It's a time to learn, expand your reach, feel out new ideas and possible goals, promote, publish, or travel. This cycle brings your needs for life experience, learning, and excitement to the fore. The routine elements of your life seem to be more drab and dull in your mind's eye now, so take extra care to attend to important matters. You are discovering new activities, subjects, and ideas, and may be branching out in a relationship or business. Today is strong for building your faith and confidence, as well as for making connections that benefit you.

The Sun begins a month-long transit of your solar eighth house today, dear Taurus, launching a month-long cycle that's great for discovering your deeper passions. This sector of your chart rules sharing on intimate and financial levels. With the Sun here, you tend to focus on connecting in a relationship or connecting with your more intimate self, discovering what makes you tick and what you truly want from life. On practical levels, there can be issues about debts or support, whether these are emotional, spiritual, or material. This cycle runs until December 21st. In the month ahead, there is a stronger focus on strategy, planning, and sharing. You are seeking out more intensity and passion in your life. You're not content with living your life without growing, changing, and improving. What is going on behind the scenes or under the layers assumes far more importance to you during this cycle. Today and tomorrow are strong for making connections on practical levels, particularly with people related to career, work, health, and business.

The Sun moves into your partnership sector today, dear Gemini, where it will transit, highlighting your relationships with others, until December 21st. Your focus is on self-expression through your relationships, negotiations, and finding ways to better balance your life during this cycle. Improving your relationships can be a goal now, and there may be increased one-on-one activity. You are expressing your power potential through close relationships, and you could be attracting strong personalities into your life. You might also pay special attention to areas of your life that have fallen out of balance as you seek more harmony, peace, and enjoyment. It's a fabulous period for ironing out differences in your relationships. Today and tomorrow, you may be connecting with someone who encourages your spirit and vision.

The Sun begins its transit of your work and health sector this morning, dear Cancer, and will spend the coming month there, spotlighting your daily affairs, routines, and habits. You'll find extra motivation to organize your daily routines and work environment, as well as improve your health. It's a busy time, although not the most glamorous time of year, but you're likely to enjoy opportunities to take charge of your life in small but significant ways. Implementing and maintaining an exercise or nutrition program can be one of your priorities in the weeks ahead. This cycle lasts until December 21st, and you'll want to take care of business! You are taking more pride in the work that you do or services you provide. Today and tomorrow, helpful connections might be made with others related to finances, real estate, home initiatives, family, and intimacy. Emotional bonds can be strengthened. You'll find that others tend to cooperate more than usual.

The Sun begins its transit of the creative sector of your solar chart today, dear Leo, and the coming month is good for letting loose the more playful, expressive side of your nature. You might pick up or renew a hobby now, or focus on other ways to enjoy your life more fully and express yourself creatively. For many, this is one of the most romantic periods of the year. You can be more outgoing than usual, or more inclined to go out on a limb. This can be a playfully competitive cycle, and also a strong time for personal attraction. The performer inside you awakens now, and you're ready to reveal your unique qualities and talents. This transit lasts about a month, until December 21st, and is a supportive, helpful, and mostly happy influence. Today can be excellent for cooperating with others. Good feelings tend to be reciprocated, and you may feel especially supported regarding your ideas and interests.

The Sun moves into your sector of home, family, and security today, dear Virgo, and this serves to awaken a stronger desire to improve your home life and relationships with family. The Sun stays here for a month, until December 21st, stirring a need to attend to your private world with more care. Personal matters, personal space, family, domestic affairs, and your base of operations take on more importance in your life now. You'll be learning about your deeper needs and considering ways to feel more nurtured and comfortable. This is a great time for activities that help you find more peace in your life and with yourself. You may be feeling nostalgic, and you're drawn to familiar activities, people, and situations. Today and tomorrow are strong for making good connections and for an easy, comfortable pace.

Until December 21st, the Sun makes its way through your communications sector, dear Libra, starting today. This is a busy, bright, and connected area of your solar chart, and the Sun here puts the spotlight on communicating, learning, sharing, connecting, and getting out and about in the weeks ahead. You take more pride in these things, so improving your daily life, communication, and sense of connectedness will go a long way toward greater happiness and fulfillment. You'll likely communicate more in your daily life, along with more movement and activity overall. It's a fine time to reach out and connect, take up new studies or interests, and share your ideas with others. You're inclined to follow your curiosity, and you're very often seeking mental stimulation. Today and tomorrow, your desire to connect or express yourself gets a boost, and your popularity may also increase. You're inclined to draw in the right people or resources to advance your goals.

The Sun exits your sign and heads into your resources sector today, dear Scorpio. Until December 21st, the spotlight is on your resources, talents, money, business affairs, comfort needs, and possessions or valuables. This is a time to build on what you already have and make the most of it. There is less emphasis on personality and personal goals, and more focus on what you can do and what you need to do it! Taking charge of your financial affairs is highly appropriate at this time in your year. It's also a great time to explore or develop a natural talent, assess your income needs, set new money-making ideas in motion, and look for ways to feel more secure and steady. In the weeks ahead, you may feel empowered by living in the here and now. Today, there can be much benefit from activities that connect you with your feelings and those you love and care about.

With the Sun moving into your sign and visiting until December 21st, dear Sagittarius, you're in a take-charge time of year. This solar cycle emphasizes your personal needs, personality, plans, and how you meet and greet the world. It's a time to attract what you truly want and need into your life more readily. In the weeks ahead, you feel more in charge of your life than usual. It's a time for making an impression! You feel more in control of your life and your destiny. Aim to strengthen your connection to the world around you for the best results. Today is strong for connecting with people who are supportive and helpful. You'll find that diplomacy takes you far today and tomorrow.

The Sun moves into your house of endings and resolutions, dear Capricorn, where it will transit until December 21st. This cycle creates a natural need for more "alone time" and more room for rest and reflection. You may be operating under the radar now, or you prefer to be in the background for a few weeks so that you can recoup your energy in preparation for your more visible birthday month. You can be tying up loose ends and attending to emotional health and happiness. You are inclined to pull back a little from situations that are excessively demanding or competitive, as this period is one of the most introspective Sun transits of the year. This is a time to process recent events and developments, as well as to dream and imagine new possibilities. You are building or rebuilding your faith in the unknown or unseen, and belief in your own inner power and strength as well. Connections with people related to business and money can be especially beneficial today and this week. You may also connect well with current partners and friends, bonding over shared values or business ideas.

The Sun begins its transit of your sector of friendship and community today, dear Aquarius, harmonizing with your sign until December 21st. This Sun transit stirs your need to connect with others, be part of a group or team, and enjoy the company of friends or like-minded groups. It's a time for people-watching, dreaming, interacting, and connecting with your revolutionary, progressive spirit. It's not a time for tying yourself down but rather for enjoying new experiences and breaking free of personal restrictions. You're more likely to get involved, as this is how you shine and express yourself best right now. Excitement about the future can stir new ideas, dreams, and plans. Today, your outlook is positive and productive. You may make favorable connections with others, particularly around finances, legal matters, publishing, and education.

With the Sun moving into your solar tenth house for a visit of a month, dear Pisces, you're more frequently concerned with your larger goals and priorities. You're a little more aware of your impact on the world, what you contribute, how others see you, and what you have to offer. Taking charge of your work or reputation comes naturally now. The weeks ahead (until December 21st) are a good time to recognize your need for more structure, planning, and goal-setting in your life. It's one of the year's more visible cycles and a time when you're more motivated than usual to do your best. This is a good day to make connections with others, particularly related to emotional health, such as counselors, and to finances and intimacy. You can experience a powerful draw to someone on an intimate level now.
